cards.ex: I've been so stressed out lately with work and everything.
cards.exUz: Oxirgi paytlarda ish va boshqa narsalar tufayli juda stressdaman.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p stressga ega bo'lgan, xavotirda bo'lgan holat.

cards.ex: She's been on edge ever since she lost her job.
cards.exUz: U ishdan bo'shatilganidan beri xavotirda.
cards.uzDef: Asabiy, xavotirda yoki qo'rqinchli his qilish.

cards.ex: He had a panic attack before the presentation.
cards.exUz: U taqdimotdan oldin vahima hujumiga uchradi.
cards.uzDef: Qo'rqinchli, to'satdan paydo bo'ladigan xavotir tuyg'usi.

cards.ex: The constant stress is really taking a toll on my health.
cards.exUz: Doimiy stress mening sog'lig'imga haqiqatan ham ta'sir qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatishi, zarar yetkazishi.

cards.ex: Don't keep your feelings bottled up; talk to someone.
cards.exUz: His-tuyg'ularingizni ichingizga yutmang; kim bilandir gaplashing.
cards.uzDef: His-tuyg'ularni yashirish, tashqariga chiqarmaslik.

cards.ex: His words really got to me.
cards.exUz: Uning so'zlari menga juda ta'sir qildi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir sizni xafa qilishi, bezovta qilishi.

cards.ex: I was worried sick when you didn't come home last night.
cards.exUz: Kechasi uyga kelmaganingizda men juda xavotirda edim.
cards.uzDef: Juda xavotirlanish, kasal bo'lib qolish darajasida.

cards.ex: I have too much on my plate right now to take on any new projects.
cards.exUz: Hozir mening zimmamda juda ko'p ish bor, yangi loyihalarni qabul qila olmayman.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p ishlarim bor, bajaradigan vazifalarim ko'p.

cards.ex: Don't lose sleep over it; it's not worth it.
cards.exUz: Bu haqda uyqusizlik qilmang; bunga arzimaydi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida juda ko'p tashvishlanish, uyquni yo'qotish.

cards.ex: Working in the emergency room is like living in a pressure cooker.
cards.exUz: Tez yordam xonasida ishlash bosimli muhitda yashashga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p stress va bosim ostida bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: Just calm down and tell me what happened.
cards.exUz: Shunchaki tinchlaning va nima bo'lganini ayting.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni tinchlantirish, asabiylashmaslik.

cards.ex: You need to get a grip and deal with the situation.
cards.exUz: O'zingizni tutishingiz va vaziyatga yechim topishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni nazorat qilish, his-tuyg'ularni boshqarish.

cards.ex: I'm at the end of my rope with these kids!
cards.exUz: Men bu bolalardan charchadim!
cards.term: at the end of my rope
cards.uzDef: Charchagan, toqatim tugagan, umidsiz holatda.

cards.ex: Try to take your mind off things by going for a walk.
cards.exUz: Sayr qilish orqali diqqatingizni boshqa narsaga qaratishga harakat qiling.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni nimadandir boshqa narsaga qaratish.

cards.ex: We're just going to chill out at home tonight.
cards.exUz: Biz bugun kechqurun uyda dam olamiz.
cards.uzDef: Tinchlanish, dam olish, stressdan xalos bo'lish.

cards.ex: I need to vent about my boss; he's driving me crazy.
cards.exUz: Men boshlig'im haqida gapirishim kerak; u meni aqldan ozdirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Muammolar yoki stress haqida gapirish.

cards.ex: She was a nervous wreck before her driving test.
cards.exUz: U haydovchilik imtihonidan oldin juda asabiy edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda asabiy va stressli odam.

cards.ex: I'm trying to keep it together, but it's hard.
cards.exUz: Men o'zimni tutishga harakat qilyapman, lekin bu qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Kuchsiz bo'lmaslik, his-tuyg'ularni nazorat qilish.

cards.ex: I always get butterflies in my stomach before a presentation.
cards.exUz: Taqdimotdan oldin doim oshqozonimda qo'rquv his qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Xavotirlik yoki qo'rquvdan oshqozonda g'alati his qilish.

cards.ex: I work best under pressure.
cards.exUz: Men bosim ostida eng yaxshi ishlayman.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p talablar yoki stress ostida bo'lish.

cards.ex: Try not to lose your cool when things get tough.
cards.exUz: Vaziyat qiyinlashganda asabiylashmaslikka harakat qiling.
cards.uzDef: Xotirjamlikni yo'qotish, asabiylashish.

cards.ex: It's such a weight off my shoulders now that the project is finished.
cards.exUz: Loyiha tugaganidan keyin juda yengil his qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Muammo hal bo'lgandan keyin yengillik hissi.

cards.ex: Don't freak out; everything will be okay.
cards.exUz: Vahimaga tushmang; hamma narsa yaxshi bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Juda xavotirlanish, qo'rqish yoki asabiylashish.

cards.ex: It's time to get over it and move on.
cards.exUz: Buni unutish va davom etish vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yomon narsani unutishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I just can't handle the stress anymore.
cards.exUz: Men endi stressga bardosh bera olmayman.
cards.uzDef: Bunga bardosh bera olmaslik, qiyinchilikka dosh bera olmaslik.

cards.ex: My doctor said my headaches are stress-induced.
cards.exUz: Doktorimning aytishicha, bosh og'rig'im stress tufayli.
cards.uzDef: Stress sababli kelib chiqqan narsa.

cards.ex: Give him some time to simmer down after the argument.
cards.exUz: Janjaldan keyin unga tinchlanish uchun vaqt bering.
cards.uzDef: Xavotir yoki g'azabni kamaytirish.

cards.ex: She's suffering from burnout after working long hours.
cards.exUz: U uzoq vaqt ishlagandan keyin charchoqdan aziyat chekmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p ishlashdan charchash va motivatsiyani yo'qotish.

cards.ex: Listening to music is my coping mechanism when I'm stressed.
cards.exUz: Stressda bo'lganimda musiqa tinglash - bu yordam usulim.
cards.uzDef: Stress yoki qiyinchilik bilan kurashish usuli.

cards.ex: The best way to overcome anxiety is to face your fears.
cards.exUz: Xavotirlikni yengishning eng yaxshi yo'li - qo'rquvlaringizga qarshi kurashish.
cards.uzDef: Qo'rquvlaringiz bilan kurashing, ulardan qochmang.
